mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS lot_id, l.item_id AS item_id, l.expiry_date AS expiry_date, l.lot_number AS lot_number, l.serial_number AS serial_number, COALESCE(SUM(sp.quantity), 0) AS total_qty FROM inventory_lot l LEFT JOIN inventory_stock_position sp ON sp.lot_id = l.id AND sp.household_id = l.household_id WHERE l.household_id = #{householdId} AND l.item_id = #{itemId} GROUP BY l.id, l.item_id, l.expiry_date, l.lot_number, l.serial_number

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.quantity), 0) FROM inventory_stock_position sp JOIN inventory_lot l ON l.id = sp.lot_id AND l.household_id = sp.household_id WHERE sp.household_id = #{householdId} AND l.item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.sql: SELECT l.id AS lot_id, l.item_id AS item_id, i.name AS item_name, l.lot_number AS lot_number, l.expiry_date AS expiry_date, COALESCE(SUM(sp.quantity), 0) AS quantity, u.name AS unit_name FROM inventory_lot l JOIN catalog_item i ON i.id = l.item_id AND i.household_id = l.household_id JOIN catalog_unit u ON u.id = i.unit_id AND u.household_id = i.household_id LEFT JOIN inventory_stock_position sp ON sp.lot_id = l.id AND sp.household_id = l.household_id WHERE l.household_id = #{householdId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND l.item_id = #{itemId} AND l.id = #{lotId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.name AS item_name, u.name AS unit_name, COALESCE(SUM(sp.quantity), 0) AS current_total, i.low_stock_threshold AS threshold FROM catalog_item i JOIN catalog_unit u ON u.id = i.unit_id AND u.household_id = i.household_id LEFT JOIN inventory_lot l ON l.item_id = i.id AND l.household_id = i.household_id LEFT JOIN inventory_stock_position sp ON sp.lot_id = l.id AND sp.household_id = i.household_id WHERE i.household_id = #{householdId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.low_stock_mode = 'CUSTOM' AND i.low_stock_threshold IS NOT NULL AND i.id = #{itemId} GROUP BY i.id, i.name, u.name, i.low_stock_threshold HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sp.quantity), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold ORDER BY i.name ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
